name: ci-agent-monorepo
description: Deterministic-core CI agent: repo-agnostic advisory review/fix/scan orchestrators around an unchanged verify pipeline, with LLM access isolated behind a fail-closed port.

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core && tsc -b packages/ollama-cloud && tsc -b packages/github && tsc -b packages/toolchains && tsc -b packages/cli
scripts.verify: npm run clean && npm ci && npm run build && npm test
scripts.verify:offline: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.verify:release: npm run lint && npm run build && npm test && npm run pack:check
